title: Introduction to Computer Organization
workloadNotes: Four projects (10% each, heavy workload, first project split into 3 parts), six individual homework assignments (lowest dropped, 10% total), weekly group discussion-pod assignment, and two exams (midterm 25%, final 25%). Up to 3% of exam weight can be replaced by a participation score. 3 free late days for projects; no late days for homework (50% credit within 24 hours late).
prerequisitesText: EECS 280 required; also EECS 203 or EECS 270.
